text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm making a bowl with balanced 
nutrition— low in sodium and packed with 
protein!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course... it's because seeing 
everyone train so earnestly truly touched 
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It may not be much, but let me cheer you 
on! —Welcome, come on in!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems her sincere attitude earned very 
high praise!
